components.cost_effect: One vector accumulator; O(n) additional memory and O(n) arithmetic per accumulated point, excluding projection and oracle work.
components.goal: Control expected objective error despite noisy iterates.
components.key_estimate: The exact selected performance statement is thm.P015.euclidean_average.
components.name: Average query points
components.operation: Accumulate pre-update points and return their arithmetic average for the constant-step policy.
components.requires: Convex feasible set and convex objective; fresh unbiased stochastic subgradients with bounded full second moment.
transfer_checks: Re-establish conditional unbiasedness after any sampling change.
A variance bound alone does not provide the required full second-moment bound.
Changing the output to the final iterate requires another analysis.

content.family: Projected stochastic subgradient with iterate averaging

limitations.statement: The stepsize uses the horizon and radius/moment information in advance; the certified output is the average of query points.
No unrestricted Oracle Complexity lower bound, last-iterate guarantee or high-probability guarantee is extracted here.

performance_links.scope_note: Expected objective gap for the positive-radius, positive-M, fixed-horizon variant only.

variants.cost: The stated recurrence performs N iid sample draws, N stochastic-subgradient evaluations and N exact projections. Projection and oracle realization costs depend on X and the implementation and are charged separately; they are not asserted to be constant-time. The explicit vector accumulation uses O(n) additional memory and O(nN) arithmetic, excluding oracle/projection work. The final x_{N+1} is not part of the average.
variants.name: Finite-horizon Euclidean robust SA
variants.output: Return s/N=(1/N) sum_{t=1}^N x_t, which belongs to X. This is Eq.(2.16) with i=1,j=N and constant weights.
public_inputs: Nonempty compact convex X in R^n and exact Euclidean projection Pi_X
Integer horizon N>=1 fixed before sampling
Known M>0 satisfying E||G(x,xi)||_2^2<=M^2 for every x in X
variants.query_and_update: For t=1,...,N: add x_t to s; draw fresh xi_t; query G_t=G(x_t,xi_t); set x_{t+1}=Pi_X(x_t-gamma G_t). The added point is the pre-update point x_t.
variants.requirements: f(x)=E[F(x,xi)] is finite, continuous and convex on X. Fresh samples xi_t are iid and independent of prior history; E[G(x,xi)]=g(x) belongs to the subdifferential of f at x. The full second moment is uniformly bounded by M^2. Exact Euclidean projection is available. No differentiability or strong convexity is required.
variants.state_and_initialization: Choose deterministic x_1 in X; initialize a vector sum s=0. Compute gamma=D_X/(M sqrt(N)).
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Use gamma=D_X/(M sqrt(N)) for all N iterations, then stop. This selected formula requires D_X,M>0. Singleton-domain handling is outside this selected positive-radius variant.

summary: Euclidean projected stochastic subgradient iteration with a predetermined constant step and the arithmetic average of query points.
title: Projected robust SA with horizon-based constant step
use_when: Minimize a continuous convex objective using fresh unbiased stochastic subgradients with a known full second-moment bound and exact projection.
